styleLock.direction: clean classic kitchen-gadget commerce with one product-matched accent
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and spec screens, cool veined marble #EAE6E1 for structure and scene screens, warm light board #F7F4EF for the closing scene, plus one accent-coloured headline band supplied per campaign
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft neutral studio light from the upper front left with a large fill card, linear specular rolls along polished steel, skimming sweep across machined texture, soft contact shadows only and never a floating product
styleLock.surfaceSystem: polished cool marble counter #EAE6E1 with soft grey veining, striped waffle-weave linen towel, light end-grain wood board, plain glass and tin props with no printed artwork
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, bold uppercase headline with one short accent rule, all in-image copy carried only as placeholders in a reserved clear zone
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #2D2D2D inside plain circular or shield outlines, no filled gradients, no shading, each paired with an empty label slot
styleLock.presentationRules: the tool keeps one consistent folded vertical silhouette for packshot and spec screens and one consistent opened diagonal silhouette for structure screens; handle shells stay a single deep tone; polished steel highlights stay linear and never blow out
noDrift: no inconsistent lighting or contradicting shadow directions
no re-scaled or re-designed product hardware
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean classic kitchen-gadget visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, cool veined marble #EAE6E1, warm light board #F7F4EF and charcoal text #2D2D2D, with one product-matched warm accent reserved for headline bands and short rules; bright soft neutral studio lighting from the upper front left with a large fill, linear specular rolls on polished steel and soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with a bold uppercase headline and one short accent rule; thin single-weight line icons with empty label slots; stable product silhouette, angle family and scale across the set; every graphic layout keeps one clear empty copy zone; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented on-image claims.

shots.background: seamless bright white #FFFFFF falling softly out of focus behind the head
shots.props: a sliver of plain tin rim at the frame edge

shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, a tight zoom on the serrated gripping wheel and the cutting blade exactly where they meet the can rim. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low side profile at roughly 15 degrees with a shallow depth of field, the machined teeth crisp in the foreground and the handle shells falling softly out of focus behind. A narrow skimming light from the left reveals every tooth and grind mark while a small bounce card keeps the steel from going flat. Seamless bright white background #FFFFFF with a sliver of plain tin rim at the frame edge. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with no extra whitespace because the texture is the subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking chrome, no invented rust, pitting or wear, no oil smears, no hands blocking the mechanism, no duplicated blade, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 白底正立面，工具折拢竖立，深色握柄壳体＋抛光钢身，顶部一体式起瓶口，机身有雕刻字标；002 大理石台面生活场景，起盖锡罐与冰饮、亚麻巾同框，左下有英文主副标题与短下划线；003 顶部整块暖红色带＋双手在砧板旁操作大锡罐切盖；004 大理石背景四枚细线图标＋标题，右侧一条竖向尺寸线并标了英寸读数；005 浅色瓷砖厨房背景，用一体式起瓶口开玻璃瓶，左上有主副标题；006 大理石背景斜置张开状态，强调大旋钮与握柄；007 品牌字标＋一家四口围桌聚餐合影；008 白底正立面尺寸标注图，含两组英寸数值。品类判定依据：无电机、无电加热的手动小件厨具，依 taxonomy 判为「家居日用／厨房用品」，明确不挂「家用电器／厨房电器」；源平台类目路径与标题提示不作判定依据，以图为准。已剥离内容：机身雕刻字标与系列名、007 的品牌字标及家庭成员可辨识面容（改为背影或颈下裁切的通用群像）、各图英文主副标题原句（一律改为 「{selling_point_n}」／「{callout_n}」 占位）、004 与 008 的具体尺寸读数（改为空白尺寸线与空标签位，数值不写死）、004 图标下的材质与耐用字样（改为空标签位与一枚空印章框）、源图暖红强调色（属品牌识别，全部改由 {accent_color} 承载，色板内不写该色）。补充：源 8 图本身不含多色色卡图，shot-08 的多柄阵列按该品类常见并列 SKU 陈列惯例补齐，色号一律由 {accent_color} 占位，未指定任何配色数量或名称。
